notes.title: INCISION - FULL 1.0 RELEASE DATE CONFIRMED
notes.content:
[h1]INCISION - FULL RELEASE CONFIRMED[/h1]

[previewyoutube=9DbQV3dfdkA;full][/previewyoutube]

[i]What started as an act of violence won’t end in an act of mercy.[/i]

[i]The Malichant Harvest Ship tore down from above, and hit the ground like an infection hitting open flesh.The Growth followed - through steel, concrete, and skin, spreading fast, deforming structure and matter into something cold, alive, and hostile. Everything gave in. What was once a city turned into a shivering carcass.[/i]

[h2]The Final Chapter[/h2]

What can you expect in the final installment? We wish to keep the biggest surprises spoiler-free, but we do have a few juicy bits to share with you. So let’s talk about your newest weapons of mass cauterisation: 

[b]New Weapon - Flamethrower:[/b]
For almost every primordial fear humanity has devised the most effective weapon - simply burn it, and Flamethrower does just that. However, should you find some stubborn growth, then you can always detach and kick the whole canister at it. 

[b]New Rocket Ammo - Nuclear Missile:[/b]
A slow, heavy rocket round made for worst-case scenarios. Because sometimes you don’t  need a scalpel, but a nuclear warhead. Just make sure to assume a safe position several kilometers away from the target. Or don’t - we won’t judge.

[h2]Price change[/h2]

This sale also marks the pen-ultimate chance to get Incision not only at a discount, but also at the Early Access base price of 14.99 USD (or your local equivalent). Since Incision will be a fully finished product with way more content in August, we think it is only reasonable to adjust the price accordingly. This way we also want to tip the hat to all of you who have been with INCISION from the start while, through this here sale, giving a window of opportunity to everyone who would like to jump in right before the very last update.

For those who would still prefer to wait till the launch, then rest assured that we won’t be raising the price of the game by more than 5$ (or your local equivalent). 

[h2]Future of Incision[/h2]

However, the launch of 1.0 is not the end of development for Incision, as there are still some surprises that SmoothBrainDev has in store for you. We will be revealing these plans soon after the launch of the game.

notes.title: Hordes of Hunger - New Demo is available
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Hyperstrangers[/h1]

Last year we announced Hordes of Hunger, our own spin on the survivorslike genre. Today, we are happy to share with you the very first public playable demo of Hordes of Hunger and of course we wouldn’t be ourselves, if we did not put a bit of strangeness into the original formula. 

[previewyoutube=_QHp-C2Tdmk;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]What can you expect from the demo:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Two hauntingly beautiful maps, each overrun by the Beast’s minions and guarded by a horrific boss.
[*] Dynamic combat system that blends the traditional survivorslike scale with arena-slasher's visceral action.
[*] Over 6 side-stories and tasks to undertake. Will you save the few last remaining citizens or focus on gathering supplies from the abandoned city - the choice and consequences are yours.
[*] Sprawling hub to which you will triumphantly return with each victor or be dragged to with each defeat. In this safe space various NPC reside, ready to help you prepare for the next battle and share their thoughts. 
[*] 10 servants of the Beats to slay or be slain by. Each with their own strengths and weaknesses to exploit. Such as the immense strength and uncontrolled rage of the  Teeth Golem which often makes it as deadly to you as to everything close to it.
[*] Two weapons and weapons arts to master. Hew and cut through with the grace of the blade or crush down all opposition the brute force the hammer.
[*] Create your own build from 5 distinct skill trees and over 30 unique skills. Ignite a fire aura, charge up a lighting storm or summon aid to the battlefield. 
[*] Get a taste of the depth of the between run progress system.  
[/list]

[h1]Play the demo[/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3241800/Hordes_of_Hunger_Demo/

[h3]Don’t forget to join the official [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.com%2Finvite%2FmHkmuvxy5w][b]discord [/b][/url]channel and [b]share your thoughts about the demo by leaving a review[/b] - we greatly appreciate your feedback[/h3]

notes.title: 0.4.5.112 - Hotfix
notes.content:
Bugfixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where Kitty didn’t spawn into E1M3 if player already had Kitty in inventory. This caused a softlock because Kitty must be picked up for the gate to open.
[*] During Mighty Spear’s cooldown if player paused the game twice it caused weapon switching to get stuck until the cooldown was finished.
[*] Loading screen for E2M4 had a typo saying “best” instead of “beast”
[*] Loading screen for E1M4 called it E1M2.

 Various changes:
[*] Mighty Spear cooldown reduced from 15 seconds to 12 seconds.
[*] Carnage Accelerator now gives player a 50% weapon damage and speed buff for 45 seconds and is not affected by shooting enemies anymore. This change was done to make the powerup easy to understand and use.
[*] Jawbreaker altfire projectiles bounce 15 times instead of 8 and move faster.
[*] Player can now skip the wait fade-in at startup and immediately enter the main menu by pressing fire, altfire, use, esc or jump.

[/list]

notes.title: Transitory Termination Update Has Arrived
notes.content:
[h1]Attention, Bloodbath Fanatics![/h1]

[b]Hope your sawblades are humming with anticipation[/b] as we have more meat for you to chew through! The newest update will let you cut down the Growth in the Transitory Termination, a place filled with even more grisly obstacles and lethal encounters. To level out the playing field, we are giving you a new toy. 

[previewyoutube=FLtWxXgX-mo;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]The new Mighty Spear ability.[/b]  Hold “kick” to unleash a powerful wide-hitting melee attack that recharges over time. Mighty Spear can be used even while wielding a gun.

[b]You are going to need it against the new new midboss, the Sentinel (The Gigachad)[/b]. Ruthless, fast, with an ability to slow you down with his projectile or his great bell, he will be the  absolute test of your abilities - a living reminder of the available difficulty sliders. You will have to move, react on time, and switch weapons to adapt to the situation. Worst of all, he is not the only one of his kind! 

[b]At least you can parry his bell with meele strikes...[/b]

One other thing, E2M1 and E2M2 boss “Mess” now dies from melee attacks only. This change has been made so as to address the confusion that many players had. The in-game tutorial texts now reflect this change.

[b]Besides that, we have a plethora of smaller features and fixes - Dig in![/b]

[h2]Major new features and changes:[/h2]

[list]
[*] New Level: E2M4 - Transitory Termination
[*] New Boss and Mini Boss: The Death-Filth Child and The Sentinel.
[*] Loading Screen Tips - To kill time, while you aren't killing stuff.
[*] New, lore-friendly first-person-view arm model and textures
[*] New ability: The Mighty Spear.
[/list]

[h2]Minor new features and fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] New explosives scattered around most levels: Gas canisters and oxygen tanks.
[*] Episode Select now shows up when selecting New Game
[*] E2M1 and E2M2 endboss “Mess” now dies from melee attacks only.
[*] Autorun is preserved between levels
[*] Revolver and chaingun spin won’t get stuck randomly anymore
[*] Revolver muzzle flash should appear in right position while rapid firing
[*] “Use” distance increased by one meter
[*] Interaction hand cursor won’t get stuck on screen anymore
[*] Increased aim sensitivity slider for controller users
[*] Health can be picked up during 1-UP death invulnerability
[*] Kitty won’t absorb ammo at full health anymore
[*] Flashlight cannot be toggled during pause anymore
[*] Hemogoblins won’t get stuck if hurt while they are idle
[*] Guns can be picked up even at full ammo now
[*] Various unintended progression skips in EP2 levels have been patched
[*] E2M2 toilets can only be flushed once to avoid spawning endless ammo
[*] ESC now leaves submenus like Options or Level Select
[*] Sawspear’s damage slightly buffed
[*] Minigun’s accuracy slightly reduced
[*] Minigun’s firing sound should play as intended
[*] Blood effects shrink if player is too close to them to avoid obstructing the screen too much
[*] Credits button in main menu
[*] E1M5 elevator music now plays correctly
[/list]

New Cheat, a spawn menu: All enemies and some items can be spawned by pressing CTRL+SHIFT+M, selecting an object from the menu using mouse, then aiming at the floor and pressing Use. This is a jank developer tool, but can be fun to play around with! 

Did you know you can activate various developer cheats by combining CTRL+SHIFT+[number]?

[h2]Known issues:[/h2]
[list]
[*] E1M4, The Filth Pit’s music after entering the indoor zone might stop for the remaining level.
[*] The screen flash when investigating a lorebit is buggy and might get interrupted or not flash at all sometimes.

notes.title: SmoothBrainDev reporting in. Update coming very soon!
notes.content:
Hello! SmoothBrainDev here, reporting at the end of E2M4 update's development. How have you been?

It sure has been a while, huh? Ever since Christmas I've been working on E2M4, Transient Termination, and the first EP2 boss, The Death-Filth Child. Along with those I've implemented one new mid-boss that will test your skills brutally and mercilessly, and there is also a new melee ability that may help even out some of that challenge.T his update is now finished on my part and is simply waiting to be released along with a trailer by Hyperstange. I believe it will be released very very soon!

[b][u]The next Termination Update[/u][/b]

E2M4 is a sort of mausoleum-furnace, a place where the Malichant store their dead in stasis, and dispose of their own kin in pits of lava and crushers. Much of their habits are a mystery, but if you trust intuition and follow the lorebits it will all make sense eventually. As always, INCISION piles on the mysteries and gives crumbs so players will have room to imagine and daydream about its story and events.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41123101/2196711f76a2c5421bfa49f37e626982209ba3c6.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41123101/9e51191be19b94cec4e7e9bd46b7e4a8b8eefcd1.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41123101/8d45067c18bd5d5b76213f20e66eb0d417519fe6.jpg[/img]


The level is dark and grim and you will meet the midboss "The Sentinel" (or as I internally call him Gigachad) a few times in this level. He can slow the player down with projectiles, and immediately goes for brutal melee berserk when the opportunity arises. Luckily for you, you can parry his melee attacks with your spear. This is where the new ability comes to play: Mighty Spear.

The Mighty Spear is engaged by holding "kick" down for a split second. It is a wide-arcing powerful move that can kill most enemies at point blank range, and parry The Sentinel's melee attacks. It has a 15 second cooldown to balance its damage output. It is also designed to soften the difficulty curve a bit in the early levels as it can dispatch many of the squishier enemies easily if player dares to approach them.

Remember, INCISION is a game that does not seek to imitate the difficulty and playstyle of other boomer shooters. It aim to be unique while still recognizable. There is no shame in playing it on lower difficulties. As the levels get harder, you should always aim to replay them starting on lower difficulty level and then raising the difficulty as your skills improve.

[u][b]What have I been working on outside of this update?[/b][/u]

I have also worked on cutscenes. I've planned to add two pre-rendered deliciously crusty retro cutscenes at the beginning and end of each three episodes. The intro of EP1 is ready, but will not be part of this update as I want to finish EP1-EP2 cutscenes fully and release them all in one package. The intro is almost *4 minutes long*. Looks like I became a movie directorwriteranimatordesigner this year!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41123101/6ccea4c0bd3f3db79ffd20b0bd7cf086dd30c4c5.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41123101/ff0da761ba545f23880dbe758221f92d036d761e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41123101/e75fad8984095dd3cfac4e6b5531834862aa594d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41123101/dee0a8194665930833d53a260cccde5d51472aa6.png[/img]


E2M5 is also almost finished. While waiting for music, QA and going through life changes I focused on that and learned new important skills to speed up game development.

I've also started a Youtube series where I play through the game one level at a time and talk about its development, my ideas on game development, how it all came to be etc. It's very amateur stuff, but fun to make nonetheless.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Af2X7pjJB2E

[u][b]What comes next?[/b][/u]

Late this summer, august - september, I'm aiming to release the rest of EP2. Here's what it will contain:

E2M5 - The Ruptured Idol
E2M6 - ???
E2Boss2 - The Matriarch
Four cutscenes, intro and outro of both episodes
Possible small balance updates and fixing of old bugs.

After these are out of the way I have a clean slate to start wrapping up the game by moving onto EP3's development. I dream of releasing the 1.0 of the game in summer 2025, and immediately move onto a second project, possibly a sequel.

The updates after that will be in two chunks: First and second half of Episode 3 instead of releasing each level seperately, adding the EP3 cutscenes to the final 1.0 update as well. I want to give players more to experience, more to replay, to talk about, to experiment with in each update and the plan to release each level seperately was just a way to make the development easier for me after the burnout. I'm over the burnout and now developing stronger than ever!

I hope this was not too weird ranty, rambly post. I've wanted to give my fans a public update for a very long time now, but I decided to wait until this E2M4 update was ready. Again, I thank everyone for their amazing love, understanding and patience as I make this massive game alone and seek to give everyone the best experience that stays truest to my vision.

Have a great summer, everyone, and let me know what you thought of this upcoming update!!

- SmoothBrainDev

notes.title: End of the year update from Smoothbraindev
notes.content:
Hello, it has been a while since I've written to the community!

Incision has been in nonstop development for a whole year now, and even if I only released a single (very large) map this year, SOON(c) a lot more is coming! The shift from Episode 1's meat-hell cityscape to a more scifi alien themes was a bit more work than I could have expected. Most of this time has been just getting a whole new arsenal of enemies done, polishing the gameplay a bit, and getting the look of the scifi levels into quality that *I* expect from this game. 

The next update, codename "Death-Filth" is coming soon and it will include quite a mountain of new and revamped content, bugfixes and small extras such as LUDICROUS GIBS! Here's a condensed list of what you can expect from it:

[h1]LEVELS[/h1]

[h2]E2M1, "Harvest Vivarium" [/h2]

This huge level has been split into two levels due to its length, density and also performance reasons. The level now ends after the "Mess" midboss fight, and E2M2 "Parasitic Relations" is the mall area after the Mess. The mall has a whole new very challenging area with amazing new music to go with it. This split should help with reported lower framerates and to keep the levels feel more fair in length knowing that losing all of your lives after 20-30 minutes of gameplay just isn't fun, and it went too far even for my pretty demanding standards.

[h2]E2M3, the episode's now titular "Death-Filth Medicine" [/h2]

This alien ship full of containers of gore and blood include four new enemies of the Malichant faction, a mysterious alien race whose part in this story is still shrouded in mystery. The level also introduces underwater (or should I say underblood) sections, and a completely new theme with graphics made by pre-rendering 3D models into textures. The episode will also be renamed after this level.

[h1]NEW ENEMIES[/h1]

Malichant Flock come in two variants, shotgun and chaingunner. They outrank most of Growth's creations in sheer damage output, but are big and slow targets.

The Sympaths are the game's first flying enemies with laser-drill eyes that may be slow to track you, but will cut you into pieces in seconds. They are weak, but move erratically and have the game's only hitscan weapon. What, a hitscan!? I am not joking.

The Favored are ninja-like experts with extreme movement speed, fastest projectiles, and ability to teleport near you to deal a nasty roundhouse kick from any distance. They will test your reflexes and reaction times more than any other foe you have faced.

[h1]WEAPONS[/h1]

Jawbreaker has an altfire which shoots ricocheting pellets that gain damage every time they bounce, eventually igniting and burning enemies as well. It's more of a fun > function firing mode, but it offers a safer way to damage enemies from behind cover, and its power is immense in tight spaces.

[h1]Last thoughts and what's next[/h1]

Next I will take a well-earned holiday vacation. After that, in January, it's time to start developing the first boss of this episode and E2M4. I want to release those two in the same update because bosses aren't very long experiences in the end. So, new boss, one new Malichant enemy, one level. I bet that sounds good for everyone.

As last message I want to thank everyone for their patience. Seriously. Incision is a solo project and the burnout from last year's crunch still haunts me occasionally. I have started changing my mindset, working habits (I'm a workaholic) and generally thinking about the game very differently, and I hope I can speed up the development next year in a healthier way. Making Harvest Vivarium taught me a hard lesson in pacing myself. I wanted to give people something after months of no updates, and I overdid it.

Going forward I want to make smaller maps more focus on making each feel unique and give players someting cool to see, more than before. It's not been wise to spend months on a single map. After all, a longer map is rarely a sign of quality! The fun you have playing a level is the only factor that matters.

[h1]SCREENSHOTS[/h1]

Here are various screenshots of what you can expect in the coming update:

notes.title: Update: INCISION v.0.4.5, codename "ETERNITY" + one more important announcement!
notes.content:
[h2]Rusteaters, it's update day![/h2]

[b]INCISION[/b] v.0.4.5 is here. The update, codenamed [i]ETERNITY[/i]* brings about MAJOR changes and improvements to the game, introducing new features, player feedback-based balance changes, tweaks, and touch-ups. Did you want to make your INCISION playthroughs even more unpredictable and hectic? Now you can, with the all-mighty [b]Randomizer Mode[/b]. Do you love bloom effect? Or at least - do you not hate bloom effect? Well, you can treat yourself to some sweet sweet image blooming. More ammo for the fan-favorite high-on-lifeblood bio-gun? Got you covered! Or maybe you'd like to juggle some mobs in the air with well-placed shots after launching them into the air with an explosion? Sure, you can. Make sure to scroll down to the Complete v.0.4.5 Changelog, but first...

*because that's how long Hyperstrange QA was making SmoothBrainDev wait for their seal of approval


[h2]INCISION OST coming soon to Steam![/h2]
There is smooth jazz, there is rough jazz, but rustcore industrial post-jazz is the best! Frédérick Chicoine "iNi" brought to the game an OST that eludes classification and for certain gives INCISION a similar edge that Nine Inch Nails music brought to the original Quake. It's weird, industrial, rough and dirty, full of horror ambiance that will make your hair stand on their ends. Just like the game, it's something else. Quite an experience. Unforgetable, even if you WANT to forget (not that you should).

[previewyoutube=9G0o5yvHOXo;full][/previewyoutube]

The OST will be hitting Steam Music Store virtual shelves on Monday, February 27. Make sure to add it to your wishlist, to be reminded of it's arrival.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2247520/INCISION_Soundtrack

Now, back to the "ETERNITY" Update.

[h2][u]Complete 0.4.5 Changelog[/u][/h2]
[h3]MAJOR ADDITIONS:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [i][b]Randomizer mode[/b][/i]. All enemies, weapons and ammo have been randomized, creating a chaotic game mode where luck is your best friend, or your worst enemy.
[*] [i][b]Two new powerups[/b][/i]: Sawspear Overcharge and Carnage Accelerator! Sawspear Overcharge doubles your Sawspear's damage for the rest of the level. Carnage Accelerator causes damage and rate of fire to increase as you damage enemies for one minute, capping at 200% damage and speed.
[/list]
[h3]WEAPONS:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Excess bullets will pass through dying enemies instead of gibbing them, making the shotgun much better at hitting multiple enemies.
[*] Sawspear's attacks hit faster reducing startup delay from 5 to 3 frames.
[*] Kitty's blood ammo from gibbed enemies now spawns a trail that homes in on player, and added a pickup text when Kitty gains blood.
[*] Kitty now gains 10 ammo instead of 5 from every gibbed enemy.
[*] Magnum, Shotgun, Machinegun, and Rocket Launcher have improved sounds.
[/list]
[h3]ENEMIES:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fire damage tics slower to make burning less overpowered.
[*] Enemies dying from burning now also splash blood to make feeding Kitty more efficient (they're still pink on the inside).
[*] Throne Firstborn's aggression and turret health reduced to make the fight slightly less chaotic.
[*] For optimization and balancing purposes, reduced enemy count in E1M4 "The Filth Pit" and E1M5 "Nerve-End", and occasionally replaced weak enemies with stronger ones.
[*] Cheeks health upgraded from 230 to 280.
[*] Spiderpope health upgraded from 210 to 260.
[*] Enemies can be bounced into air with explosives and shooting them while airborne keeps them in the air for longer.
[*] Removed an out of bounds enemy which prevented getting 100% in Filth Pit.
[/list]
[h3]OPTIONS:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Resolution changing should now work properly both in main menu and in-game.
[*] VSync works as intended now.
[*] Added bloom and chromatic aberration visual effects.
[/list]
[h3]MISC CHANGES:[/h3]
[list]
[*] New main menu theme.
[*] Many of the secrets made easier to spot and more rewarding.
[*] Projectile stability adjusted to prevent fast projectiles from passing through thin objects. This affects Soldiers, Clinkers, Maws and Cheeks.
[*] Blood mist from gibs disappears faster to avoid too much visual clutter on screen.
[*] Dithering effect has been reduced on each level.
[*] Various small performance improvements in enemy code, weapon code, and especially when enemy projectiles and effects are spawned.
[*] Increased ambient lighting on E1M6.
[*] HP can’t go above 200 by collecting stim injectors.
[*] Added a new shortcut/secret to Feral Armament.
[*] Tumor and teleport sounds are now affected by volume slider.
[/list]

notes.title: Post-release update
notes.content:
Hello, SmoothBrainDev here!

It's been roughly two months since the Early Access release of INCISION, and I'm so happy and so so thankful by people's response to the game. It's been a blast watching people stream it, make videos, post screenshots and especially give feedback to me.

As some might have noticed, the updates have been scarce lately and I haven't been visiting the forums very much. I was, and still am, quite burned out after the release. But I'm finally trying to get back to speed with the development of Episode 2 (as seen in these two teaser pictures), and to polish the game a bit while doing so, while taking care of not falling into yet another burnout accidentally.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41123101/961cc3dc0df4a52ee91dcb48d06505d94fa3be07.png[/img]

So what's next? I'm working on an update with many small additions to the game. Some of them include:

- Physics for enemies so shooting, blowing up and kicking enemies sends them flying. I always felt the enemies were a bit too rigid and needed an extra layer of fun.

- Enviromental hazards to use with enemy physics. Kicking enemies into giant fans, anyone?

- Brightness/contrast options

- Last used weapon keybind

- Updates on visual clarity such as toned down dithering, less obstructive gore, better visuals for feeding Kitty etc.

- Possible addition of powerup pickups. You know, to even out your odds against the brutal opposition.

I hope everyone enjoys INCISION and keeps supporting its development as it evolves. Thank you again!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41123101/eaedd468789df87c5b5ca1e4ccc0e09110e7d7a9.png[/img]

notes.title: POSTAL: Brain Damaged update, Blood West Chapter 2, Supplice release date, INCISION release, new games in the catalog, and more Realms Deep 2023 news from Hyperstrange
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38371631/1699b1f20e514af85e9d00ea02a216d728938311.png[/img]

[h1]Hyperstrangers![/h1]

It is [i]that[/i] time of the year again. Boomercon is upon us! Or Realms Deep 2022, if you will. We've had six announcements this year, so let's jump into it without further ado. This serves just as a summary - more detailed posts will be popping up on appropriate game pages within a day or two. Let's go!

[h2]INCISION - Early Acces launch + Special Offers![/h2]
[previewyoutube=qlgqps4wcbU;full][/previewyoutube]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1734680/INCISION/
Check out our nevest, explosive release! INCISION is a rare gem - a very retro-looking, unforgiving throwback shooter, that's so full of wonderfully-executed ideas, that it feels fresh and juicy. That is if you like your juice in the taste of rust, rot, and horror. The game launched on the day of Realms Deep main event - 16 September, and is already gaining a lot of praise from the players on Steam. If you like games such as DUSK, you can't afford to miss INCISION. And speaking of DUSK - DUSK owners get extra 15% off the price that's been already lowered by 15% in the release week. Similar discount applies for owners of Nightmare Reaper and Hedon, with even more bundles on the way! Get your tetanus shot, and plunge into the horror now!

[h2]POSTAL: Brain Damaged - Horde Mode announcement[/h2]
[previewyoutube=xoMT9iW_690;full][/previewyoutube]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1359980/POSTAL_Brain_Damaged/
POSTAL: Brain Damaged has already gotten a small balancing update. Now, on September 19 it's getting another one. Much more substantial - it should help a lot with the balance between exploration and combat, thanks to the new ammo mechanics. Wait, that's not what you just saw in the video above? That's very perceptive! November 10 will mark the release of the Horde Mode in POSTAL: Brain Damaged, so you can spend even more time with the Brain Damaged Dude! 

[h2]Blood West - Chapter 2 announcement[/h2]
[previewyoutube=ll6tFR5ebg4;full][/previewyoutube]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1587130/Blood_West
Your favorite eerie wild west stealth-shooter with a bit of a immersive sim aftertaste has exceeded our initial expectations as to the reception and popularity. In wake of such success the Blood West team has been expanded, and the project was granted an extended development schedule, to deliver more content than it was originally intended. The second out of 3 chapters in the story of the Revenant Gunslinger will hit Steam on Halloween, and you'll be getting a map that's 1.5 larger and tighter packed with events and NPCs then the first one.

[h2]Supplice - release date announcement[/h2]
[previewyoutube=2YS2ZCjBTnw;full][/previewyoutube]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1693280/Supplice/
According to some sources, Supplice is the best-looking game in the entire Hyperstrange catalog. Well, beauty takes time! We've hold off making the announcement of the release date, to make sure Mekworx team has enough time to work their magic. Now, we're happy to announce the date you've been dying to know: [b]30 march 2023[/b]!

[h2]77p Egg: Eggwife - new game announcement[/h2]
[previewyoutube=OXD0zCu0rJw;full][/previewyoutube]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1317020/77p_egg_Eggwife/
We fell in love with Eggwife after first seeing it in the Realms Deep 2021 showcase. Now, after we've released POSTAL: Brain Damaged it's perfectly clear, that the audience wants us to take things a step further. Or a lot of steps further. To go so far, that we'll end up in UK. Eggwife is what would happen if the Brits came up with POSTAL, but... it's so much more. An immersive sim? A dating sim? A shopping cart driver sim? You name it! Maybe just go wishlist it, and get the Demo for you to plau

[h2]GHOSTWARE: Arena of the Dead - new game announcement[/h2]
[previewyoutube=qAiV6YUVacM;full][/previewyoutube]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1893370/GHOSTWARE_Arena_of_the_Dead/
We strive to bring overlooked, original titles to a broader audience. Sometimes originality isn't apparent at face value. What seems like an arena shooter with retro stylings happens to become a whole sprawling world full of adventure and danger. You can find out for yourself just what makes Ghostware so unique that it found its way to our hearts. We'e not sure of the release date yet with this one, but we do highly encourage you to wishlist it and take the available demo for a spin.

And that's that. We'll be happy to hear your thoughts on our Hyperstrange Discord, steam forums, and clay tablets. Thank you for being a part of the Hyperstrange crowd, and Stay Metal!

[h2]Your's truly,[/h2]
